title: Obr Baseline
notes:
CT: databank Receipts U (onshore); GDP: Aggregates AE. BI is a derived nominal projection, NOT an official nominal OBR forecast: ONS NPEK CP SA fiscal sum /1000 anchored at 2025-26, multiplied by OBR Table 1.1 F real BI ratio and Table 1.7 V GDP-deflator ratio relative to anchor. GDP deflator proxies the BI deflator; assumption agreed in #8 comment 6710911267. Formula: NPEK_base*(NPEL_t/NPEL_base)*(GDPdeflator_t/GDPdeflator_base). Current rates from rate history. Sources D-ons-investment, D-obr-efo and D-obr-databank.
